% Pattern: number/format. A format that ends in a dot, as
% \renewcommand{\thedefinition}{S.\arabic{definition}.}, prints the dot after
% the number, and the number is S.1. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want definition-1 definition S.1
% want definition-2 definition S.2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{definition}{Definition}
\renewcommand{\thedefinition}{S.\arabic{definition}.}
\begin{document}
\begin{definition} A space is fine when it is compact. \end{definition}
\begin{definition} A space is good when it is finite. \end{definition}
\end{document}
